checkbox.$description: Tokens of `checkbox`: its box and its mark.

size.$description: Width and height of the box.

border-width.$description: Border width of the box. The mark is twice as thick.

border-color-invalid.$description: Border color of the box while an error shows.

background-color.$description: Background color of the box, unchecked.

checked-background-color.$description: Background and border color of the box, checked or indeterminate.

mark-color.$description: Color of the check mark and of the indeterminate bar.

focus-ring-offset.$description: Space between the control and its focus ring.
